title: Lechon Kawali with Turkey and Ham
description: A fusion Filipino dish with crispy pork belly, turkey, and ham. Perfect for a party or gathering.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, combine vinegar, water, salt, black pepper, garlic, and bay leaves.
2. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
3. Add the pork belly to the pot and simmer for 30 minutes or until the meat is tender.
4. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
5. Remove the pork belly from the pot and let it cool slightly.
6. Cut the pork belly into bite-sized pieces and deep-fry until crispy.
7. Grill the turkey breast until cooked through.
8. Slice the ham into thin pieces.
9. Assemble the dish by placing the crispy pork belly on a platter, topped with sliced turkey and ham.
